import bpy, os

scene = bpy.context.scene
# make the active scene unmistakable
scene.name = 'CHATGPT_DO_ZERO_OK'

obj = bpy.data.objects.get('Corpo_Principal')
if obj:
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    obj.hide_set(False)
    obj.hide_viewport = False
    obj.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obj

framed = 0
for window in bpy.context.window_manager.windows:
    screen = window.screen
    for area in screen.areas:
        if area.type != 'VIEW_3D':
            continue
        region = next((r for r in area.regions if r.type == 'WINDOW'), None)
        space = area.spaces.active
        try:
            space.region_3d.view_distance = 30.0
            space.overlay.show_overlays = True
            space.shading.type = 'SOLID'
            space.clip_end = 10000.0
        except Exception:
            pass
        if region and obj:
            with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window, screen=screen, area=area, region=region):
                bpy.ops.view3d.view_selected(use_all_regions=False)
            framed += 1

for area in bpy.context.screen.areas:
    area.tag_redraw()

try:
    bpy.ops.wm.redraw_timer(type='DRAW_WIN_SWAP', iterations=5)
except Exception:
    pass

def draw(self, context):
    self.layout.label(text='CHATGPT: ARQUIVO DO ZERO ATIVO')
    self.layout.label(text=f'Objetos: {len(bpy.data.objects)}')
    self.layout.label(text='Objeto selecionado: Corpo_Principal')
try:
    bpy.context.window_manager.popup_menu(draw, title='ChatGPT Blender Bridge', icon='INFO')
    popup = True
except Exception as e:
    popup = False

print('PID=' + str(os.getpid()))
print('FILEPATH=' + repr(bpy.data.filepath))
print('SCENE=' + bpy.context.scene.name)
print('OBJECT_COUNT=' + str(len(bpy.data.objects)))
print('COLLECTIONS=' + ','.join(c.name for c in bpy.data.collections))
print('HAS_CORPO_PRINCIPAL=' + str(obj is not None))
print('FRAMED=' + str(framed))
print('POPUP=' + str(popup))
